data.one_liner: On-device NSFW and explicit content detection for images, videos, and camera feeds.
data.what_it_does: Analyzes images, videos, picked media, photo libraries, and camera frames on-device for NSFW content using machine learning models. It operates completely locally without server uploads or telemetry.
use_when: You need to moderate user-uploaded media or camera streams directly on the device.
Privacy and data compliance require that media never leaves the user's phone.
You want to scan local video files, photo libraries, or picked media items.
avoid_when: You are targeting web platforms for anything other than one-shot file and byte scanning.
You cannot accept the app bundle size overhead of bundled or downloadable ML models.
Your application depends on features requiring cloud-based neural networks.
strengths: Runs entirely on-device with no media uploads or external telemetry.
Supports both image and video files, camera feeds, URLs, and photo library assets.
Includes customizable ensembles, per-category thresholds, and decision stores.
weaknesses: Model weights increase app size or require dynamic downloading.
Detection is probabilistic and must be treated as a single moderation signal.
Photo library and camera scanning require strict platform permission configurations.
data.setup_notes: Requires platform-specific usage descriptions in Info.plist (iOS) and permissions in AndroidManifest.xml for camera and photo library access.
